description: Search the dblp computer science bibliography (about 10 million papers, articles, theses and proceedings) from a stored copy of the publisher's CC0 bulk release. Matches words in the title, author names, venue and year; a title or an author name typed as a phrase is matched as a phrase first ("attention is all you need", "Yoshua Bengio"). Results are newest first within each match class. Every answer carries data_as_of, answered_from and the licence. Default 30 results, max 100.
